tips.text: Bank Aya before Varzia's window opens; neither Aya nor relics you hold expire when her stock rotates.
Buy extra Blade relics from Varzia; every one carries the Blade as the Rare.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine only the Rare relics to Radiant; Radiant lowers the Common odds, so leave Common relics Intact.
Crack the Rare relics in a Radiant radshare squad so every player brings the same Radiant relic.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
